forbidden: 1-minus-Kaplan-Meier treating native close as ordinary censoring for the primary V2 probability.
Selecting display horizons because the curve looks favorable.
cumulative_incidence_policy.interpretation: Descriptive for the audited cohort; not proof of a population-level probability.
skip_if: Coverage loss cannot be handled defensibly.
Phase B exposure ledger is not certified.

fail_or_stop_conditions: Phase A or B not certified.
Event-time analysis ignores competing native close.
Cumulative incidence is presented despite unresolved material coverage/ordering defects.
Reference diagnostics are restricted only to triggered lifecycles.
Clustering/dependence is ignored while events are visibly concentrated.
Any result is used to tune V2 or create V3 inside Phase C.
fixed_analysis_rules: Use all distinct observed event times for the primary event-time table.
Do not choose 24h/48h/etc as primary analytical cutoffs based on results.
If fixed display points are needed, they must be operationally preregistered before viewing Phase C results.
Median among observed V2 cases may be labeled only as median among observed V2 cases.
If a cohort-level event-time quantile is not estimable, report NOT_ESTIMABLE.
Descriptive sensitivity must not be converted into an optimization loop.

market_dependence_diagnostic.event_concurrency: Number of audited lifecycles simultaneously at risk at each event time.
forbidden_claims: Episode count equals effective independent sample size.
market_dependence_diagnostic.goal: Expose shared exposure/clustering without pretending to estimate independent effective sample size.
market_dependence_diagnostic.regime_episode_policy: If an already-authorized frozen market-regime series exists, an episode is a contiguous period of the same existing regime on the frozen benchmark. Do not invent new episodes through correlation optimization.
required_summaries: Distribution of Memory/V2 across dates and existing regime episodes where available.
Descriptive leave-one-existing-episode-out sensitivity using the same rule for every episode where meaningful.

objective: Explain V2 frequency through timing, observation support, frozen-reference age and shared market exposure before making any decision-usefulness claim.
pass_criteria: All conclusions distinguish observation from generalization.
Timing is interpreted jointly with number-at-risk and valid evaluation opportunities.
Reference age is measured without changing V2.
No economic claim, exit recommendation, tuned threshold, or new detector is introduced.

definitions.strict_new_running_high: Strict update of the declared running-high state; do not label it a new market structure without a separate definition.
definitions.subsequent_progress_event: New occurrence of the existing frozen Memory formula.

rules: Reference age at V2 equals time from first Memory to V2; do not count these as independent evidence.
Do not refresh, roll, replace, or optimize the frozen reference.
Do not use quantity, PnL, MFE, MAE, fees, or economic outcome fields.
Describe triggered and non-triggered paths through their terminal observation point.
